name: Studio Storage Console
description: A clean-lined storage console with warm wood finishes and practical open shelving. Designed to bring color, display space, and everyday organization to a modern living room.

name: Panorama Platform Bed
description: A low-profile platform bed with a calm, minimal silhouette. Its sturdy frame and natural wood look make a comfortable centerpiece for a bright, contemporary bedroom.

name: Lounge Modular Sofa
description: A generous modular sofa with deep seats and soft neutral upholstery. Its flexible layout and relaxed proportions make it an inviting choice for family rooms and entertaining spaces.

name: Cognac Leather Two-Seater
description: A compact two-seater sofa upholstered in rich cognac-toned leather. Clean proportions, supportive cushions, and a timeless profile bring an understated accent to smaller spaces.

name: Marble Top Coffee Table
description: An elegant coffee table pairing a smooth marble-look top with a solid wood base. Its balanced size works in front of any sofa, giving you room for books, trays, and coffee.

name: Nordic Reading Armchair
description: A cozy reading armchair with a curved back, soft boucle-style fabric, and solid wooden legs. A perfect quiet corner companion for long evenings with a book and warm light.

name: Oak Dining Set for Six
description: A welcoming six-seat dining set crafted with an oak-look tabletop and comfortably padded chairs. Built for daily family meals and ready to host weekend gatherings with ease.

name: Minimalist Work Desk
description: A streamlined home-office desk with a spacious top, cable-friendly back edge, and sturdy metal legs. Keeps your laptop, lamp, and notebooks organized while looking sharp in any room.

name: Grand Showcase Wardrobe
description: A tall wardrobe with wide mirrored panels, hanging space, and interior shelving for folded clothes. A statement storage piece that makes bedrooms feel bigger, brighter, and tidier.

name: Cloud Fabric Accent Chair
description: A light accent chair with plush cushioning and gently rounded arms. Easy to move between the living room and bedroom, it adds instant comfort wherever extra seating is needed.

name: Scandi Bedside Table Duo
description: A pair of matching bedside tables with a drawer and open shelf each. Keep your lamp, book, and charger close at hand while the soft-close drawer hides the clutter beautifully.

name: Family Comfort Sectional
description: A large L-shaped sectional with washable-look covers, deep chaise seating, and stain-resistant fabric. Designed for movie nights, naps, and real family life without worrying about mess.
